title: SFT V4 dataset manifest
description: Describes one frozen V4 dataset build. Interface only — this file does not generate data. The V3 audit (2026-07-29) found that provenance was unrecorded (0 of 1515 rows carried a trace) and that the eval split shared 81.5% of its artists with train. Both are recorded here as required, machine-checkable fields so the next build cannot be shipped without answering them.

manifest_version.description: Schema version of this manifest, not of the data.

dataset_version.description: Frozen build identity. Rolling back means selecting an earlier value, never editing a JSONL in place.

generator_commit.description: Commit of the repo that produced the build. Without it a dataset cannot be regenerated.

splits.description: Three splits with different jobs. `regression` is the existing V3-era eval kept for continuity; it shares entities with train and therefore cannot measure generalisation. `sealed` is the only split allowed to gate a release.

validator.description: Which gate produced the recorded verdict.

hard_findings.description: Must be 0 for a build intended for full training. A non-zero value is allowed only for a build explicitly marked preflight-only.

counts_by_request_kind.description: Per-class row counts. The V3 eval had 1 sample in three of five classes, where one sample is worth 100 percentage points and a 3pp gate is unmeasurable. Recording the counts makes that visible before training rather than after.

min_rows_per_request_kind.description: Smallest class size, i.e. the split's measurement resolution. 100/this = percentage points per sample.

sampleProvenance.description: Per-row provenance. Every row in a V4 build carries these fields under its `meta` key. data.sft.v4_contract validates real JSONL rows against this definition; merely defining it under $defs is not a gate.

seed_source.description: Where the user turn came from. A build whose seeds are all template_expansion is measuring its own templates.

trace_id.description: Execution trace this row was derived from. Required for production and controlled-harness executions.

execution_environment.description: Distinguishes real product traffic from deterministic fault injection. It is omitted when no tool observation exists.

observation_origin.description: `none` is a single-shot planner row. `real_execution` is product traffic. `harness_execution` is an actual ToolPlan run with controlled fault injection. Teacher-authored failures are forbidden.

sealedPolicy.description: The disjointness the sealed split must satisfy, recorded as measured values rather than as an intention. The V3 eval satisfied episode disjointness and still shared 81.5% of its artists with train.

entity_disjoint.description: artist / song / album sets share nothing with train. Not negotiable: a sealed set that reuses train entities cannot distinguish learning from memorising.

template_disjoint.description: Entity-blind normalised query forms share nothing with train.

episode_namespace.description: Episode ids are prefixed so a cross-split join is impossible by accident.

seed_pool.description: Identifier of the seed batch. Must differ from every seed pool listed for train.

measured.description: What the validator actually observed. Intent is not evidence.

max_near_dupe_jaccard.description: Highest character 5-gram Jaccard between any sealed row and any train row. 0.6 is the ceiling; V3's eval peaked at 0.84.

release_gates.description: Thresholds a candidate model must clear on the sealed split. Recorded in the manifest so a build cannot be graded against gates chosen after seeing the score.

sealed_vs_regression_max_gap_pp.description: Guards against the failure the V3 eval could not see: strong on familiar entities, collapsing on unseen ones.
